title: Authorized user defines rental pricing structure
gherkin:
Feature: Rental cost calculation rule
  Scenario: Authorized user defines rental pricing structure
    Given an authorized user is logged into the pricing configuration layer
    When the user defines a new rental pricing structure with base rate and duration multipliers
    Then the pricing structure is successfully created and stored in the system
    And the structure is available for application to rentable items
rationale: Tests the core capability from operative context that authorized users can define rental pricing structures. This is foundational to the rental cost calculation rule.
usedContextItems: Pricing configuration layer allows authorized users to define rental pricing structures and apply them to rentable items
